description_en: Obtains or downloads the logs of a node for a task. The logs are from the stdout and stderr of the system and user scripts
description_zh: 获取（或者下载）任务某个节点的日志，日志来源于系统和用户脚本的stdout和stderr
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dlc get-pod-logs --job-id dlc-20210126170216-00000 --pod-id dlc-20210126170216-00000-chief-0 --pod-uid fe846462-af2c-4521-bd6f-96787a570000 --max-lines 100 --start-time 2020-11-08T16:00:00Z --end-time 2020-11-08T17:00:00Z --download-to-file true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPodLogs
